verses.ar: وَعَادَ أَلِيهُو فَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
verses.web: Elihu also continued, and said,
verses.he: וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃

verses.ar: «ٱصْبِرْ عَلَيَّ قَلِيلًا، فَأُبْدِيَ لَكَ أَنَّهُ بَعْدُ لِأَجْلِ ٱللهِ كَلَامٌ.
verses.kjv: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that [I have] yet to speak on God’s behalf.
verses.web: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
verses.he: כַּתַּר־לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י עֹ֖וד לֶאֱלֹ֣והַּ מִלִּֽים׃

verses.ar: أَحْمِلُ مَعْرِفَتِي مِنْ بَعِيدٍ، وَأَنْسُبُ بِرًّا لِصَانِعِي.
verses.kjv: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.web: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.he: אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָחֹ֑וק וְ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן־צֶֽדֶק׃

verses.ar: حَقًّا لَا يَكْذِبُ كَلَامِي. صَحِيحُ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ عِنْدَكَ.
verses.kjv: For truly my words [shall] not [be] false: he that is perfect in knowledge [is] with thee.
verses.web: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
verses.he: כִּֽי־אָ֭מְנָם לֹא־שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּעֹ֣ות עִמָּֽךְ׃

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا ٱللهُ عَزِيزٌ، وَلَكِنَّهُ لَا يَرْذُلُ أَحَدًا. عَزِيزُ قُدْرَةِ ٱلْقَلْبِ.
verses.kjv: Behold, God [is] mighty, and despiseth not [any: he is] mighty in strength [and] wisdom.
verses.web: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
verses.he: הֶן־אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב׃

verses.ar: لَا يُحْيي ٱلشِّرِّيرَ، بَلْ يُجْرِي قَضَاءَ ٱلْبَائِسِينَ.
verses.kjv: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
verses.web: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.
verses.he: לֹא־יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃

verses.ar: لَا يُحَوِّلُ عَيْنَيْهِ عَنِ ٱلْبَارِّ، بَلْ مَعَ ٱلْمُلُوكِ يُجْلِسُهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْكُرْسِيِّ أَبَدًا، فَيَرْتَفِعُونَ.
verses.kjv: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings [are they] on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.web: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
verses.he: לֹֽא־יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת־מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃

verses.ar: إِنْ أُوثِقُوا بِٱلْقُيُودِ، إِنْ أُخِذُوا فِي حِبَالَةِ ٱلذِّلِّ،
verses.kjv: And if [they be] bound in fetters, [and] be holden in cords of affliction;
verses.web: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,
verses.he: וְאִם־אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹֽנִי׃

verses.ar: فَيُظْهِرُ لَهُمْ أَفْعَالَهُمْ وَمَعَاصِيَهُمْ، لِأَنَّهُمْ تَجَبَّرُوا،
verses.kjv: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
verses.web: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.
verses.he: וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃

verses.ar: وَيَفْتَحُ آذَانَهُمْ لِلْإِنْذَارِ، وَيَأْمُرُ بِأَنْ يَرْجِعُوا عَنِ ٱلْإِثْمِ.
verses.kjv: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
verses.web: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
verses.he: וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃

verses.ar: إِنْ سَمِعُوا وَأَطَاعُوا قَضَوْا أَيَّامَهُمْ بِٱلْخَيْرِ وَسِنِيهِمْ بِٱلنِّعَمِ.
verses.kjv: If they obey and serve [him], they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.web: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.he: אִֽם־יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַ֫עֲבֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטֹּ֑וב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃

verses.ar: وَإِنْ لَمْ يَسْمَعُوا، فَبِحَرْبَةِ ٱلْمَوْتِ يَزُولُونَ، وَيَمُوتُونَ بِعَدَمِ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ.
verses.kjv: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
verses.web: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.
verses.he: וְאִם־לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי־דָֽעַת׃

verses.ar: أَمَّا فُجَّارُ ٱلْقَلْبِ فَيَذْخَرُونَ غَضَبًا. لَا يَسْتَغِيثُونَ إِذَا هُوَ قَيَّدَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
verses.web: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.
verses.he: וְֽחַנְפֵי־לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם׃

verses.ar: تَمُوتُ نَفْسُهُمْ فِي ٱلصِّبَا وَحَيَاتُهُمْ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَأْبُونِينَ.
verses.kjv: They die in youth, and their life [is] among the unclean.
verses.web: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.
verses.he: תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים׃

verses.ar: يُنَجِّي ٱلْبَائِسَ فِي ذِلِّهِ، وَيَفْتَحُ آذَانَهُمْ فِي ٱلضِّيقِ.
verses.kjv: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
verses.web: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
verses.he: יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְיֹ֑ו וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽם׃

verses.ar: «وَأَيْضًا يَقُودُكَ مِنْ وَجْهِ ٱلضِّيقِ إِلَى رَحْبٍ لَا حَصْرَ فِيهِ، وَيَمْلَأُ مَؤُونَةَ مَائِدَتِكَ دُهْنًا.
verses.kjv: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait [into] a broad place, where [there is] no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table [should be] full of fatness.
verses.web: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.
verses.he: וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨ ׀ מִפִּי־צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא־מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃

verses.ar: حُجَّةَ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ أَكْمَلْتَ، فَٱلْحُجَّةُ وَٱلْقَضَاءُ يُمْسِكَانِكَ.
verses.kjv: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold [on thee].
verses.web: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.
verses.he: וְדִין־רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃

verses.ar: عِنْدَ غَضَبِهِ لَعَلَّهُ يَقُودُكَ بِصَفْقَةٍ. فَكَثْرَةُ ٱلْفِدْيَةِ لَا تَفُكُّكَ.
verses.kjv: Because [there is] wrath, [beware] lest he take thee away with [his] stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
verses.web: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.
verses.he: כִּֽי־חֵ֭מָה פֶּן־יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרָב־כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל־יַטֶּֽךָּ׃

verses.ar: هَلْ يَعْتَبِرُ غِنَاكَ؟ لَا ٱلتِّبْرَ وَلَا جَمِيعَ قُوَى ٱلثَّرْوَةِ!
verses.kjv: Will he esteem thy riches? [no], not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
verses.web: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?
verses.he: הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֖וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹֽחַ׃

verses.ar: لَا تَشْتَاقُ إِلَى ٱللَّيْلِ ٱلَّذِي يَرْفَعُ شُعُوبًا مِنْ مَوَاضِعِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.web: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.he: אַל־תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲלֹ֖ות עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃

verses.ar: اِحْذَرْ. لَا تَلْتَفِتْ إِلَى ٱلْإِثْمِ لِأَنَّكَ ٱخْتَرْتَ هَذَا عَلَى ٱلذِّلِّ.
verses.kjv: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.web: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.
verses.he: הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל־אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־עַל־זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا ٱللهُ يَتَعَالَى بِقُدْرَتِهِ. مَنْ مِثْلُهُ مُعَلِّمًا؟
verses.kjv: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
verses.web: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?
verses.he: הֶן־אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹחֹ֑ו מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מֹורֶֽה׃

verses.ar: مَنْ فَرَضَ عَلَيْهِ طَرِيقَهُ، أَوْ مَنْ يَقُولُ لَهُ: قَدْ فَعَلْتَ شَرًّا؟
verses.kjv: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
verses.web: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?
verses.he: מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכֹּ֑ו וּמִֽי־אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃

verses.ar: اُذْكُرْ أَنْ تُعَظِّمَ عَمَلَهُ ٱلَّذِي يُغَنِّي بِهِ ٱلنَّاسُ.
verses.kjv: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
verses.web: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
verses.he: זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי־תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳלֹ֑ו אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ يُبْصِرُ بِهِ. ٱلنَّاسُ يَنْظُرُونَهُ مِنْ بَعِيدٍ.
verses.kjv: Every man may see it; man may behold [it] afar off.
verses.web: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.
verses.he: כָּל־אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ־בֹ֑ו אֱ֝נֹ֗ושׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֹֽוק׃

verses.ar: هُوَذَا ٱللهُ عَظِيمٌ وَلَا نَعْرِفُهُ وَعَدَدُ سِنِيهِ لَا يُفْحَصُ.
verses.kjv: Behold, God [is] great, and we know [him] not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
verses.web: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.
verses.he: הֶן־אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא־חֵֽקֶר׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ يَجْذُبُ قِطَارَ ٱلْمَاءِ. تَسُحُّ مَطَرًا مِنْ ضَبَابِهَا
verses.kjv: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
verses.web: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,
verses.he: כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי־מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֹֽו׃

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي تَهْطِلُهُ ٱلسُّحُبُ وَتَقْطُرُهُ عَلَى أُنَاسٍ كَثِيرِينَ.
verses.kjv: Which the clouds do drop [and] distil upon man abundantly.
verses.web: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.
verses.he: אֲשֶֽׁר־יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י ׀ אָדָ֬ם רָֽב׃

verses.ar: فَهَلْ يُعَلِّلُ أَحَدٌ عَنْ شَقِّ ٱلْغَيْمِ أَوْ قَصِيفِ مِظَلَّتِهِ؟
verses.kjv: Also can [any] understand the spreadings of the clouds, [or] the noise of his tabernacle?
verses.web: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?
verses.he: אַ֣ף אִם־יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁאֹ֗ות סֻכָּתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: هُوَذَا بَسَطَ نُورَهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ، ثُمَّ يَتَغَطَّى بِأُصُولِ ٱلْيَمِّ.
verses.kjv: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
verses.web: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.
verses.he: הֵן־פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אֹורֹ֑ו וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ بِهَذِهِ يَدِينُ ٱلشُّعُوبَ، وَيَرْزُقُ ٱلْقُوتَ بِكَثْرَةٍ.
verses.kjv: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
verses.web: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.
verses.he: כִּי־בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן־אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃

verses.ar: يُغَطِّي كَفَّيْهِ بِٱلنُّورِ، وَيَأْمُرُهُ عَلَى ٱلْعَدُوِّ.
verses.kjv: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it [not to shine] by [the cloud] that cometh betwixt.
verses.web: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
verses.he: עַל־כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה־אֹ֑ור וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃

verses.ar: يُخْبِرُ بِهِ رَعْدُهُ، ٱلْمَوَاشِيَ أَيْضًا بِصُعُودِهِ.
verses.kjv: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
verses.web: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.
verses.he: יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵעֹ֑ו מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל־עֹולֶֽה׃
